evals.prompt: Compile all we have done here into .md file and any other assets into .zip. Just like a handoff. (Session: the three steps PIM ad in truvio/pim-ads/three-steps, with intake answers from Grady and several of Claude's own layout calls.)
evals.expected_output: handoff-three-steps.md in the task folder following the template, and three-steps-handoff.zip packed by the script, committed and pushed.
assertions: A handoff-*.md file exists in the task folder root
A <task>-handoff.zip exists and every file sits under one top-level folder
Every markdown link and image in the handoff resolves to a file inside the zip
Sections run in order: Where it stands, Next steps, Open items before the brief and decisions
Decisions are split into 'Grady chose' and 'Claude's calls (not reviewed yet)'
Open items is a table with a Who column, and no owner is invented
The brief copy is quoted unchanged
Every stand-in (fonts, badge, mapping UI, lockup) is named with what replaces it
No Museo Slab font file and no secret in the zip
Writing has no em dashes and no semicolons

evals.prompt: I'm off from Thursday for a week. Wrap up the booth 425 convergence work so someone on the team can pick up the Shot B edit without me.
evals.expected_output: A handoff for truvio/booth-425-convergence that reads its storyboard, prompt and git log, states which shots are approved and which are pending, and asks only for the gaps (who picks it up, the deadline).
assertions: Asks who picks the work up and any missing deadline in one question call, or writes 'unknown, ask Grady'
Session log uses dates and commit ids from git history
Next steps start with the Shot B work
Does not credit Grady with the trade show 3D shell or booth placement
Zip includes the plates, keyframes and logos the handoff links to

evals.prompt: Can you package the messy item card for Jess to review? She just needs to see where it is and what's still open.
evals.expected_output: Stakeholder variant: status, decisions, open items and visuals, without the files table, commands or QA. The zip holds the finals only.
assertions: Uses the stakeholder variant: no commands, no files table, no QA section
Keeps status, decisions, open items and the final image
Zip excludes the source folder and HTML mock
Mentions the open landing page as an open item
